AnimeThemes_PluginDesc: Anime themes plugin. Provides stylized anime theme support for the application.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_AnimeThemeProvider: Provides anime-themed UI visual styles (like Sakura Bloom, Neon Genesis, Weathering Blue).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_AnimeTranslationProvide: Provides UI localization and multi-language translation support for the Anime Themes plugin.
